# Someday our kids will design the living world

In our vision of the future, our children will program biology like we once programmed computers. In
that world, they will cure all diseases and grow everything they can imagine.

[Let's grow][17]
[Ginkgo bioworks imagery on new york stock exchange building ]

## Labwork is the bottleneck for biotechnology

Autonomous labs are the answer

Science still runs on manual benchwork, and that bottleneck slows progress on everything from novel
materials to lifesaving medicines. Autonomous labs replace the bench, letting scientists order
experimental work from robots just by asking for it.

This shift doesn’t replace scientists; it empowers them to focus on insight, creativity, and
judgment rather than manual lab work.

[What is an autonomous lab?][18]
See ours in action
AUTONOMOUS LABS

## Build your own autonomous lab

# Someday our kids will design the living world

In our vision of the future, our children will program biology like we once programmed computers. In
that world, they will cure all diseases and grow everything they can imagine.

[Let's grow][17]
[Ginkgo bioworks imagery on new york stock exchange building ]

## Labwork is the bottleneck for biotechnology

Autonomous labs are the answer

Science still runs on manual benchwork, and that bottleneck slows progress on everything from novel
materials to lifesaving medicines. Autonomous labs replace the bench, letting scientists order
experimental work from robots just by asking for it.

This shift doesn’t replace scientists; it empowers them to focus on insight, creativity, and
judgment rather than manual lab work.

[What is an autonomous lab?][18]
See ours in action
AUTONOMOUS LABS

  Business Solutions
  
  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to
  support the entire healthcare ecosystem.
  
  [ Explore ][51]
  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

As a global leader in the science of nutrition, we nourish those who need extra care, fill nutrition
gaps and provide innovative products for a healthier future, enabling customers and patients to live

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

benefits in the colon, having a beneficial impact on the bacteria already living there.²

## DISCOVER BIOPROX

### Human size, industrial scale

Bioprox Healthcare is a European probiotic manufacturing company with 50 years of expertise. We
offer high-quality probiotics, postbiotics, and contract fermentation services with a
customer-centric approach.

We bring your products to life, striving to seamlessly complement your team and become your in-house
process development and production department.  Experience the personalized service of a human-sized
company, the reliability of a partner with a strong track record and let our brand-new probiotic
manufacturing facility increase your competitiveness.

Bioprox Healthcare is an industry member within the International Probiotics Association (IPA).

## At a Glance

### Your trusted probiotic partner, defined by the numbers

HEALTHCARE

INNOVATION

50 years
of expertise in industrial fermentation

in our company

dedicated to R&D

40+ export countries
around the world

1000+ m²
of dedicated R&D facilities

## TECHNOLOGICAL CAPABILITIES

### At your service

Each probiotic and postbiotic development project is unique and complex, requiring a customized
approach to achieve success. In addition to our cultures, we offer third-party industrial toll
manufacturing services, specializing in the optimization and the production of your proprietary
strains.

By leveraging our state-of-the-art probiotic manufacturing facility and Research and Development
center, we provide a comprehensive suite of tailored solutions to support your probiotic
development, including:

• development studies for new strains (including postbiotic development)
• stability improvement
• optimization of industrial yields

[Lab development][13][Toll manufacturing][14]

## biotic solutions

### Custom Probiotic & Postbiotic Manufacturing Solutions

As a leading probiotic manufacturer, Bioprox Healthcare is dedicated to enhancing human and animal
well-being through a range of high-quality bulk cultures and freeze-dried probiotics.

Our carefully selected strains have been scientifically developed through expert probiotic
development processes to meet the growing demand for innovative applications across diverse sectors,
including:
* human dietary supplements
* pet food
* cosmetics
* food
* beverages

These unique bacteria interact with the microbiomes of humans and animals in distinct ways,
depending on their specific properties and customized formulations.

## Enzymes

[Eznyme manufacturer-Biovencer]

Biovencer Healthcare is one of the leading enzyme suppliers, distributors & exporters in India.
Enzymes are biocatalysts that when present in a chemical reaction, increase the rate of a reaction
without affecting the property and nature of the end product. Almost all enzymes are proteins, but
not all proteins are enzymes.

Enzymes are highly specific in their action; therefore, each enzyme catalyzes only one type of
reaction. Enzyme activity can be influenced by a change in pH, temperature, and the concentration of
substrate present and can be described by the Turnover Number. Our range of Enzymes that are
distinctive, reliable, and 100%  safe for consumption.

## Probiotics

[Probiotics Manufacturer -Biovencer]

Biovencer Healthcare is one of leading Probiotic manufacturers, suppliers, distributors & exporters
in India. Probiotic microorganisms have been part of our food from many centuries, without our
knowledge but they always benefited us. The best example probiotic containing food is curd, which
contains billions of Lactobacillus strains, imparting health benefits by maintaining our gut
(intestine) flora for good digestion. 

We are one of the leading Yeast manufacturers, suppliers and exporters in India. We manufacture two
types of active instant dry yeast, Brewer's Yeast used in wine and beer production and  Baker's
Yeast, which is used in baking bread and other bakery products.

[More Info][57]

## Enzymes

[Eznyme manufacturer-Biovencer]

Biovencer Healthcare is one of the leading enzyme suppliers, distributors & exporters in India.
Enzymes are biocatalysts that when present in a chemical reaction, increase the rate of a reaction
without affecting the property and nature of the end product. Almost all enzymes are proteins, but
not all proteins are enzymes.

Enzymes are highly specific in their action; therefore, each enzyme catalyzes only one type of
reaction. Enzyme activity can be influenced by a change in pH, temperature, and the concentration of
substrate present and can be described by the Turnover Number. Our range of Enzymes that are
distinctive, reliable, and 100%  safe for consumption.

Is medication cost included?
Yes! You only pay for the treatment you choose.
How does the medication work?
Our clinicians prescribe GLP-1 (glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist) medications where they are
clinically appropriate for weight management.

GLP-1 is a naturally occurring hormone that helps regulate appetite and food intake. It sends
signals to the brain that increase feelings of fullness, reduce hunger, and can slow the rate at
which the stomach empties.

Research suggests that some people living with overweight or obesity may have reduced GLP-1
signalling. GLP-1 medications work by mimicking the action of this naturally occurring hormone,
helping you feel fuller for longer and reducing appetite.

GLP-1 medications are not a quick fix. They are designed to support sustainable weight loss when
used alongside healthy dietary choices, regular physical activity, and long-term lifestyle changes.
Why do you need my Identity Document?
As a regulated clinical service provider, we are legally obligated to verify your identity before we
can prescribe or supply you with any medication.

This is the same as when registering with your GP or Dentist.

The I.D. Document you supply is simply used to verify your online account details are current and
accurate.
Will my information be kept confidential?
We never share any information without your permission.

All your account and medical data is kept completely confidential.

Is medication cost included?
Yes! You only pay for the treatment you choose.
How does the medication work?
Our clinicians prescribe GLP-1 (glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist) medications where they are
clinically appropriate for weight management.

GLP-1 is a naturally occurring hormone that helps regulate appetite and food intake. It sends
signals to the brain that increase feelings of fullness, reduce hunger, and can slow the rate at
which the stomach empties.

Research suggests that some people living with overweight or obesity may have reduced GLP-1
signalling. GLP-1 medications work by mimicking the action of this naturally occurring hormone,
helping you feel fuller for longer and reducing appetite.

GLP-1 medications are not a quick fix. They are designed to support sustainable weight loss when
used alongside healthy dietary choices, regular physical activity, and long-term lifestyle changes.

**Frequented asked questions**

Email us at [hello@bulkprobiotics.com][9].

#### Why should I take probiotics?

You are home to a community of 38,000,000,000,000 microorganisms (mostly bacteria) that live in and
on you. They perform critical functions like digesting food, managing inflammation, and synthesizing
key vitamins, metabolites and neurotransmitters. This is your microbiome.

However, modern living disturbed the balance of this ecosystem. Antibiotic overuse combined with
alcohol, sugar, tobacco, disrupted sleep, city-living, decreased breastfeeding, stress, poor diet,
and other environmental factors, have depleted the diversity and richness of our microbiomes and
impacted our health.

This goes beyond simple digestive issues. BulkProbiotics version of Garden of Life contains doctor
formulated probiotic strains that deliver core benefits to the gastrointestinal system which, in
turn, influence systemic health.

#### When will I feel something?

Everyone’s body is different, and the benefits you may ‘feel’ (reduced bloating, more regular bowel
movements, higher energy) are often just the most visceral ones.

Many people feel results in as a little as 24-48 hours due to localized benefits like improved
digestion. Other longer term benefits like cardiovascular health and metabolic function may take
longer, or you may not notice anything at all. That’s completely normal. As long as you continue
your daily intake, those beneficial microbes are doing their work inside to program, sustain, and
enhance your health.

#### Are your probiotics compatible with my diet or dietary restrictions?

Yes.

This is free from: Dairy • Gluten • Soy • GMOs • Binders • Preservatives • 11 other classes of
allergens defined by the European Food and Safety Authority (EFSA)

It adheres to the following diets: Vegan • Vegetarian • Ketogenic • Intermittent Fasting

#### Will your probiotics survive digestion?

Yes. We select strains that are great at surviving stomach and bile acids.

We do not recommend taking probiotics in acid-resistant capsules that skip digestion. Your mouth,
esophagus, and stomach have thriving communities of microbes (if you're up for it, we suggest you
open the capsule and either mix in a drink or pour the contents directly into your mouth; if you
exerience any kind of indigestion within 2 hours of eating or GERD/acid reflux, we highly recommend
doing this).

#### Do you have an office in Iceland?

No.

We have purchased our website name/domain from Namecheap. When anyone purchases a website
name/domain from Namecheap their contact details are automatically replaced with an address in
Iceland to protect them from spam and identify theft.
[https://www.namecheap.com/blog/domain-privacy-is-changing-at-namecheap/][10]
"Having scoured the globe for a domain privacy service that matches our needs, we’ve selected
Withheld for Privacy, based in Iceland, a country known for its privacy standards."
 
We ship from the state of Georgia in the USA (we previously had a presence in the state of
Washington).
 

#### Can I pick up my order in person?

Unfortunately, we do not offer local pickup.

#### Where is my order?

**I got an email saying my order was shipped using USPS but my tracking doesn't show any updates
yet.** When we transfer packages to the USPS they are not scanned by them immediately. The USPS
transports them to a distribution center where packages are sorted and scanned for the first time.
Sometimes packages can get stuck during this period of transport without any scans even though we've
given your package to the USPS and there may be a delay in when it gets scanned. Please give the
tracking 1-2 days to update. If you feel like this is not the case, please email us and we will help
you!

#### Can probiotics have a salty taste?

All probiotics taste different. Most people have only ever taken probiotics in a capsule, so the
smell and taste of various probiotics may be new.

For example, probiotics like L. Rhamnosus GG and Clostridium Butyricum commonly use sodium salt
components in the fermentation process, which is why they may have or over time develop a salty
taste.

 

 

#### Do you ship with an ice pack?

No. It's not necessary because the probiotics are freeze dried so they can withstand warm
temperatures during transportation. The ice pack will become the same temperature as the air in just
a few hours.

 

 

**Our Story**

Our mission at BulkProbiotics is to make Gut Health accessible to everyone and we primarily do this
by making probiotic formulations more affordable.

After many years of suffering and with no help from conventional doctors, many people wish they
would have discovered the power of probiotics earlier. Whether you have SIBO, IBS, colitis, candida,
brain fog/fatigue, etc we highly recommend experimenting with probiotics.

**Frequented asked questions**

Email us at [hello@bulkprobiotics.com][9].

#### Why should I take probiotics?

You are home to a community of 38,000,000,000,000 microorganisms (mostly bacteria) that live in and
on you. They perform critical functions like digesting food, managing inflammation, and synthesizing
key vitamins, metabolites and neurotransmitters. This is your microbiome.

However, modern living disturbed the balance of this ecosystem. Antibiotic overuse combined with
alcohol, sugar, tobacco, disrupted sleep, city-living, decreased breastfeeding, stress, poor diet,
and other environmental factors, have depleted the diversity and richness of our microbiomes and
impacted our health.

This goes beyond simple digestive issues. BulkProbiotics version of Garden of Life contains doctor
formulated probiotic strains that deliver core benefits to the gastrointestinal system which, in
turn, influence systemic health.

#### When will I feel something?

Everyone’s body is different, and the benefits you may ‘feel’ (reduced bloating, more regular bowel
movements, higher energy) are often just the most visceral ones.

Many people feel results in as a little as 24-48 hours due to localized benefits like improved
digestion. Other longer term benefits like cardiovascular health and metabolic function may take
longer, or you may not notice anything at all. That’s completely normal. As long as you continue
your daily intake, those beneficial microbes are doing their work inside to program, sustain, and
enhance your health.

#### Are your probiotics compatible with my diet or dietary restrictions?

Yes.

This is free from: Dairy • Gluten • Soy • GMOs • Binders • Preservatives • 11 other classes of
allergens defined by the European Food and Safety Authority (EFSA)

It adheres to the following diets: Vegan • Vegetarian • Ketogenic • Intermittent Fasting

#### Will your probiotics survive digestion?

Yes. We select strains that are great at surviving stomach and bile acids.

We do not recommend taking probiotics in acid-resistant capsules that skip digestion. Your mouth,
esophagus, and stomach have thriving communities of microbes (if you're up for it, we suggest you
open the capsule and either mix in a drink or pour the contents directly into your mouth; if you
exerience any kind of indigestion within 2 hours of eating or GERD/acid reflux, we highly recommend
doing this).

#### Do you have an office in Iceland?

No.

We have purchased our website name/domain from Namecheap. When anyone purchases a website
name/domain from Namecheap their contact details are automatically replaced with an address in
Iceland to protect them from spam and identify theft.
[https://www.namecheap.com/blog/domain-privacy-is-changing-at-namecheap/][10]
"Having scoured the globe for a domain privacy service that matches our needs, we’ve selected
Withheld for Privacy, based in Iceland, a country known for its privacy standards."
 
We ship from the state of Georgia in the USA (we previously had a presence in the state of
Washington).
 

#### Can I pick up my order in person?

Unfortunately, we do not offer local pickup.

#### Where is my order?

**I got an email saying my order was shipped using USPS but my tracking doesn't show any updates
yet.** When we transfer packages to the USPS they are not scanned by them immediately. The USPS
transports them to a distribution center where packages are sorted and scanned for the first time.
Sometimes packages can get stuck during this period of transport without any scans even though we've
given your package to the USPS and there may be a delay in when it gets scanned. Please give the
tracking 1-2 days to update. If you feel like this is not the case, please email us and we will help
you!

#### Can probiotics have a salty taste?

All probiotics taste different. Most people have only ever taken probiotics in a capsule, so the
smell and taste of various probiotics may be new.

For example, probiotics like L. Rhamnosus GG and Clostridium Butyricum commonly use sodium salt
components in the fermentation process, which is why they may have or over time develop a salty
taste.

 

 

#### Do you ship with an ice pack?

No. It's not necessary because the probiotics are freeze dried so they can withstand warm
temperatures during transportation. The ice pack will become the same temperature as the air in just
a few hours.

 

 

**Our Story**

Our mission at BulkProbiotics is to make Gut Health accessible to everyone and we primarily do this
by making probiotic formulations more affordable.

After many years of suffering and with no help from conventional doctors, many people wish they
would have discovered the power of probiotics earlier. Whether you have SIBO, IBS, colitis, candida,
brain fog/fatigue, etc we highly recommend experimenting with probiotics.

Do not use Florastor or other probiotics in any ICU setting and in those individuals with open
arterial and venous access required (such as a Vascath, Permcath, or AV fistula).

considered severely immunocompromised or critically ill.

Do not use Florastor probiotics if allergic to any components (especially yeast). Less than 1% of
patients experience constipation or thirst.

Very rarely, side effects such as: allergic reaction (skin rash). Fungemia or sepsis in patients
with a central venous catheter, and in hospitalized, immunocompromised patients may occur.

not intended for use by consumers or to substitute for appropriate professional care.

The Gut–Brain Connection

## When your gut’s off, it doesn’t stay in your gut

It starts in your stomach — then it follows you everywhere. The bad days at your desk. The 3 a.m.
wake-ups. The edge you can’t shake. You already feel the connection. The science finally explains
it.

Bloating Gas Constipation that flares with stress Brain fog Low energy Restless sleep Anxiety

Your gut and your brain talk to each other all day along the **gut–brain axis** — a two-way line of
nerves, immune signals, and chemical messengers that the bacteria in your gut help shape. When that
conversation goes quiet in the wrong way, you feel it as digestion *and* mood, focus, sleep, and
stress. Fix the wrong things and nothing moves. Map what’s actually there, and you finally have an
answer worth acting on.

[Start with your map →][92] [Take the gut–brain quiz][93]
The Difference

## Why generic probiotics fail

A shelf probiotic gives everyone the same strains and hopes some of them matter to you. Your gut
isn’t average — so an average formula keeps missing. Flore starts from your data instead of a guess.

Generic probiotic

### A guess in a bottle
* Same strains for millions of different guts
* Chosen for shelf life and cost, not for you
* No idea what your microbiome is actually missing
* You keep buying. The symptoms keep coming back.

Flore

### Mapped to you
* Built from your own microbiome sequencing data
* Strains chosen for the gaps your gut actually shows
* Matched against 40,000+ real formulation outcomes
* One precise formula — your answer, not everyone’s

The Flore ecosystem

## Your gut is an ecosystem. So is ours.

Flore turns what’s actually inside you into a plan that’s actually yours — then keeps learning as
you do. You’re not buying a bottle. You’re joining a living system that gets smarter with every
person in it.

Test-to-Treat means your data leads: it decides the intervention — probiotic, prebiotic, phage, or a
combination — not a one-size-fits-all guess. And every result makes the next person’s plan sharper.
That’s the ecosystem: real people, real data, compounding.

# Golden is now part of *ComplyAdvantage.*

We set out to build a self-constructing knowledge graph of the world's information. In 2024, that
technology found its home inside ComplyAdvantage — powering financial crime intelligence for over
1,000 enterprises.

2017
Founded
$59.5M
Raised
a16z
Lead backer
2024
Acquired
SF
Headquarters
The acquisition

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."
[Visit ComplyAdvantage →][5]
The story

## A self-constructing knowledge base.

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

Founded · 2017 Golden

Jude Gomila starts Golden in San Francisco to combine artificial and human intelligence into one
continuously reconciled record.

Seed · 2019 $5M

a16z, Founders Fund, Gigafund and SV Angel back the first self-constructing knowledge database.

Series A · 2021 $14.5M

Led by a16z; Marc Andreessen joins the board. Golden closes a $1M US Air Force contract.

Series B · 2022 $40M

a16z leads again to scale the graph, bringing Golden's total funding to roughly $59.5M.

Acquired · 2024 ComplyAdvantage

Golden joins ComplyAdvantage to power AI-enriched financial crime intelligence worldwide.

The team

## Founder, engineers, and the investors behind them.

Golden was founded by Jude Gomila — a Cambridge engineer who previously co-founded the mobile
platform Heyzap (acquired 2016) — and built by a small team of AI, NLP and knowledge-graph
specialists.

Founder & CEO Jude Gomila

Set the mission of mapping the world's knowledge; now board observer and special advisor at
ComplyAdvantage.

Lead investor a16z

Andreessen Horowitz backed every round; Marc Andreessen served on Golden's board.

Backers Founders Fund

With Gigafund, SV Angel, DCVC and angels — roughly $59.5M raised across seed, Series A and Series B.

The team AI & NLP

Engineers specialising in data extraction, entity disambiguation and large language models — now
part of ComplyAdvantage's data science team.

[GOLDEN.com][6]

A self-constructing knowledge graph founded in San Francisco in 2017. Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in
2024.

# Golden is now part of *ComplyAdvantage.*

We set out to build a self-constructing knowledge graph of the world's information. In 2024, that
technology found its home inside ComplyAdvantage — powering financial crime intelligence for over
1,000 enterprises.

The acquisition

## Acquired by ComplyAdvantage in 2024.

On 24 April 2024, ComplyAdvantage — the AI-driven financial crime intelligence firm protecting over
1,000 enterprises across 75 countries — acquired Golden.

01

### Into the ingestion layer

Golden's data extraction and entity-disambiguation methods now feed ComplyAdvantage's ingestion
pipeline, sharpening real-time risk insights for regulated institutions.

02

### Two teams, united

Golden's AI and large-language-model specialists joined ComplyAdvantage's data science team to build
on interconnected data at scale.

03

### Founder as advisor

Founder and CEO Jude Gomila joined ComplyAdvantage as a board observer and special advisor. a16z
became a top shareholder of the combined company.

"Financial crime insights built on *interconnected data* have been our north star."
[Visit ComplyAdvantage →][5]
The story

## A self-constructing knowledge base.

Golden set out to map human knowledge with machine intelligence — automating one of the world's
largest knowledge graphs from millions of disparate sources.

Founded · 2017 Golden

Jude Gomila starts Golden in San Francisco to combine artificial and human intelligence into one
continuously reconciled record.

Seed · 2019 $5M

a16z, Founders Fund, Gigafund and SV Angel back the first self-constructing knowledge database.

Series A · 2021 $14.5M

Led by a16z; Marc Andreessen joins the board. Golden closes a $1M US Air Force contract.

Series B · 2022 $40M

a16z leads again to scale the graph, bringing Golden's total funding to roughly $59.5M.

Acquired · 2024 ComplyAdvantage

Golden joins ComplyAdvantage to power AI-enriched financial crime intelligence worldwide.

The team

## Founder, engineers, and the investors behind them.

Golden was founded by Jude Gomila — a Cambridge engineer who previously co-founded the mobile
platform Heyzap (acquired 2016) — and built by a small team of AI, NLP and knowledge-graph
specialists.

Founder & CEO Jude Gomila

Set the mission of mapping the world's knowledge; now board observer and special advisor at
ComplyAdvantage.

Lead investor a16z

Andreessen Horowitz backed every round; Marc Andreessen served on Golden's board.

Backers Founders Fund

With Gigafund, SV Angel, DCVC and angels — roughly $59.5M raised across seed, Series A and Series B.

The team AI & NLP

Engineers specialising in data extraction, entity disambiguation and large language models — now
part of ComplyAdvantage's data science team.

## GUTolution Tech

** Amplicon Sequencing** **(used by other companies)**
Focuses on specific parts of the microorganisms rRNA genes. It helps identify microbes but has
limits in resolution.

**Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS) (used by GUTolution)**
Examines the entire genetic material in a sample, providing more detail. It can:
* Detect bacteria, fungi, viruses, and parasites at once.
* Classify microbes more precisely (down to species or strain level).
* Reveal potential metabolic functions, helping us understand how microbes work.

WGS gives a clearer, more complete picture of your microbiome compared to amplicon sequencing.

## Say Goodbye To

### Constipation

Probiotics can regulate microbiota, boost organic acid levels to enhance muscle movement, and
shorten colon transit time, ultimately aiding in the relief of constipation - [Learn More][35]

### Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)

Probiotics can help restore gut balance, reducing inflammation, and improving digestive function to
alleviate the symptoms of IBS - [Learn More][36]

### Weight Management Troubles

Probiotics can improve digestion, regulate appetite hormones, and reduce fat absorption, ultimately
supporting better metabolic health for weight management - Learn More

### Depression and Mental Health Issues

An imbalance in gut bacteria can cause inflammation and change how serotonin is made, disrupting
communication between the gut and brain, which may lead to or worsen depression - [Learn More][37]

### Poor Immunity

Probiotics can boost our immune system by enhancing microbiome diversity and reducing markers of
systemic inflammation, helping to fight off harmful pathogens and support overall immune function -
[Learn More][38]

### Allergy and Skin

The gut-skin axis suggests that imbalances in the gut microbiome, known as dysbiosis, can contribute
to or exacerbate skin conditions by affecting immune responses, inflammation, and the skin’s barrier
function - [Learn More][39]

### Bloating

Probiotics can help reduce bloating by improving gut motility and digestion, as specific strains aid
in breaking down food more effectively, leading to less gas production - [Learn More][40]

## GUTolution Tech

** Amplicon Sequencing** **(used by other companies)**
Focuses on specific parts of the microorganisms rRNA genes. It helps identify microbes but has
limits in resolution.

**Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS) (used by GUTolution)**
Examines the entire genetic material in a sample, providing more detail. It can:
* Detect bacteria, fungi, viruses, and parasites at once.
* Classify microbes more precisely (down to species or strain level).
* Reveal potential metabolic functions, helping us understand how microbes work.

WGS gives a clearer, more complete picture of your microbiome compared to amplicon sequencing.

# Comprehensive Healthcare Services for Every Stage of Life

Healthway Medical provides comprehensive care for all life stages, including family medicine,
telemedicine, vaccinations, health screenings, and specialised consultations — delivering trusted
and affordable healthcare for you and your family.

[Explore Our Solutions][91]
[

###### Telemedicine

Skip the long waits and trips to the doctor! With telemedicine, access quality healthcare from home,
anytime, anywhere.

View Details
][92] [

###### Vaccinations

Stay protected at every stage of life. From childhood immunisations to adult boosters and travel
vaccines, keeping up to date helps prevent serious illness and supports long-term health. Book your
vaccination at a clinic near you.

View Details
][93] [

###### Clinic Health Screenings

As early detection leads to more effective treatment, it is important to go for regular health
screening, even if you feel fine. Through checkups, potential health problems can be identified and
managed before they become critical.

View Details
][94] [

A legal document that allows you to appoint someone to make decisions on your behalf if you lose
mental capacity. Secure your future with peace of mind.

View Details
][95] [

###### Advance Medical Directive (AMD)

A legal document that allows you to state your healthcare preferences in advance, ensuring your
wishes are respected if you become unable to communicate.

View Details
][96] [

###### Sports & Fitness Health Screening

injuries, and optimise your performance.

### Need Help Finding Care?
### Our 24/7 Contact Center is Here for You!

### SCAN ME

We understand that finding the right care can be challenging. That’s why our dedicated team is
available 24/7 to provide support and assistance. Whether you need to schedule an appointment or
have questions about our services, we’re here to make it easy for you to get the care you need.

# Why our kind of care is what you need

### Humanized Healthcare for Everyone

Behind your health condition, HMN understands who you are – a person with varying, complex needs.
That’s why we take time to get to know you, so we can provide better care for you.

### We Give Our All, For One

Every patient gets a team of healthcare providers combining their expertise to address your complete
healthcare needs. This is how our team of doctors, nurses, and staff work together to make you feel
better holistically.

# What Patients Say About Their Experience With Us

"Natutuwa ako doon sa mga tao doon. Talagang accommodating sila, kahit saan, sa X-ray room, talagang
ineentertain nila yung mga pasyente. Pagka may tanong ang pasyente, kunyari mga naghihintay,
talagang sinasagot nila, ineexplain nila."

"I bring my mom to Shangri-La every weekend for her PT (physical therapy). Sinabi niya sa akin “uy
ang ganda pala sa Healthway”. Sa sobrang natuwa siya binilhan niya pa ng Jollibee yung nag-PT sa
kanya"
PrincessHealthway Outpatient Center Patient’s Caregiver
"Maasikaso yung mga tao ng Qualimed. Magaling sila makisama. Parang kinocomfort po nila yung mga
pasyente."
GraceHealthway Qualimed Hospital Patient

We understand that finding the right care can be challenging. That’s why our dedicated team is

# Why our kind of care is what you need

### Humanized Healthcare for Everyone

Behind your health condition, HMN understands who you are – a person with varying, complex needs.
That’s why we take time to get to know you, so we can provide better care for you.

### We Give Our All, For One

Every patient gets a team of healthcare providers combining their expertise to address your complete
healthcare needs. This is how our team of doctors, nurses, and staff work together to make you feel
better holistically.

## Good health begins

Probiotics help reduce bloating, manage weight, promote vaginal health, and balance mood.

### Digestive Support

A healthy gut microbiome helps manage bloating, inflammation, and digestive issues like IBS and
SIBO.

### Kids Development

A balanced gut supports immune function, digestion, and brain development for lifelong health.

### Longevity

A well-balanced gut supports digestion, immunity, and brain function for healthy aging.

### Mental Performance

A thriving gut supports brain function, reduces fog, improves sleep, and helps manage stress.

### Recovery & Strength

A strong gut supports muscle recovery, reduces inflammation, and improves nutrient absorption.

### Biohacking

A diverse microbiome enhances cognition, gut-brain connection, and full-body optimization.

I developed the concept for Kefir Lab during my master’s program in Disruptive Innovation and
International Business. As a certified nutritionist, with additional studies in food science,
fermentation, and the chemistry of cooking through Harvard programs, I work directly with Italian

Today, Kefir Lab is built with 100 trillion live probiotics, featuring strains sourced primarily
from European laboratories and independently third-party tested for quality and efficacy.

More than a probiotic drink, Kefir Lab is my vision for a modern wellness ritual rooted in European
fermentation science, longevity, and the belief that gut health is the foundation of overall
wellness.

The Role of Regulatory Agencies in the Probiotic Industry

At KefirLab, we are committed to providing high-quality, scientifically backed probiotic
formulations that support gut health, immunity, and overall well-being.

As part of that commitment, we ensure transparency in how our products are made, the research behind
them, and the regulatory standards we adhere to.

### How Probiotics Are Regulated

Probiotics are classified as dietary supplements in many countries, including the United States and
Canada.

This means they fall under specific regulatory frameworks that differ from pharmaceuticals. In the
U.S., the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) oversees dietary supplements under the Dietary
Supplement Health and Education Act (DSHEA) of 1994.

In Canada, probiotics are regulated as Natural Health Products (NHPs) under Health Canada’s Natural
and Non-Prescription Health Products Directorate (NNHPD).

Unlike pharmaceuticals, which require premarket approval, dietary supplements do not need FDA or
Health Canada approval before being sold.

However, manufacturers are responsible for ensuring their products are safe, properly labeled, and
supported by scientific evidence.

The FDA and Health Canada monitor supplements through post-market surveillance, enforcing
regulations on mislabeling, contamination, and false claims.

### Science-Backed Claims at KefirLab

We believe in the power of probiotics, and our claims are rooted in scientific research. Every
statement we make about the benefits of our probiotics is supported by clinical studies on specific
probiotic strains.

While regulations prevent supplement companies from making drug-like claims (such as curing or
treating diseases), we ensure that our statements about digestive health, immune function, and
microbiome balance are substantiated by peer-reviewed research.

The Role of Regulatory Agencies in the Probiotic Industry

At KefirLab, we are committed to providing high-quality, scientifically backed probiotic
formulations that support gut health, immunity, and overall well-being.

As part of that commitment, we ensure transparency in how our products are made, the research behind
them, and the regulatory standards we adhere to.

### How Probiotics Are Regulated

Probiotics are classified as dietary supplements in many countries, including the United States and
Canada.

This means they fall under specific regulatory frameworks that differ from pharmaceuticals. In the
U.S., the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) oversees dietary supplements under the Dietary
Supplement Health and Education Act (DSHEA) of 1994.

In Canada, probiotics are regulated as Natural Health Products (NHPs) under Health Canada’s Natural
and Non-Prescription Health Products Directorate (NNHPD).

Unlike pharmaceuticals, which require premarket approval, dietary supplements do not need FDA or
Health Canada approval before being sold.

However, manufacturers are responsible for ensuring their products are safe, properly labeled, and
supported by scientific evidence.

The FDA and Health Canada monitor supplements through post-market surveillance, enforcing
regulations on mislabeling, contamination, and false claims.

### Science-Backed Claims at KefirLab

We believe in the power of probiotics, and our claims are rooted in scientific research. Every
statement we make about the benefits of our probiotics is supported by clinical studies on specific
probiotic strains.

While regulations prevent supplement companies from making drug-like claims (such as curing or
treating diseases), we ensure that our statements about digestive health, immune function, and
microbiome balance are substantiated by peer-reviewed research.

We apply the most advanced technologies and scientific approaches to study human health and

We offer probiotic strains and blends that are documented, and custom formulations produced to the
highest quality standards. From the selection of added-value ingredients up to the finished product

We offer probiotic solutions for the health supplement and nutricosmetic markets, as well as
probiotics for food and beverage applications. We are offering contract development and
manufacturing services to produce the next generation of probiotics and live biotherapeutics.

*What makes us unique*

## We are a team of innovators

### We are passionate

about creating the world’s leading science-based, natural medicine.

### We build and create collaboration

Working with the leading innovators across the world, from both the very best supplier ingredient
providers, through to leading research practitioners and consumer brands.

### We are constantly seeking

the very latest market trends, scientific research and ingredients.

### We develop strong working partnerships

with leading customers across the globe. Driven by the same commitment to provide the
highest-quality, science-based nutraceutical products to enhance the health and wellness of people
worldwide.

## Introducing our unique probiotic capabilities

**We are the first TGA compliant Probiotic contract manufacturing facility ready to fully implement
the new TGA guidelines.**

We work closely with the world’s leading science-based probiotic suppliers.

Our state-of-the-art in-house probiotic manufacturing facility provides our customers evidence
based, secure shelf-life innovative blends of probiotic strains as well as advanced post-biotics and
spore-based products of the highest quality.
We have invested in the very latest scientific and manufacturing technology. Our validation qPCR

## “Dito ko na-realize, iba ang nagagawa ng malasakit. Pumupunta ako ng Makati Life kasi may
## nararamdaman ako, pero sa paraan ng kanilang pag-aalaga, mararamdaman mo talagang tutulungan ka
## nilang mapabuti. Sa bungad palang may babati na sa ‘yo, hanggang makalabas ka, sasabihan ka ng
## ‘ingat.’ Mas nagkakaroon ako ng pag-asang gumaling.”

#### Silvestra Biñas

MLMC Patient

## “I used to go to other private hospitals, but Makati Life has been my go-to ever since I went
## here. May option ka rin na gamitin ‘yung Yellow Card mo- at lahat ng procedures mo ay libre,
## hanggang sa mga gamot. Before kasi, tinitiis ko nalang ‘yung nararamdaman ko, pero dahil sa
## Makati Life- mas kinakaya ko dahil anumang oras, bukas ang kanilang OPD. Wala nang dahilan para
## matakot ako hanggang nandito ang Makati Life.”

#### Angelito Verano

mlmc patient

## “Bilang isang kabataan, hindi ko naiisip before na mahalaga pala ang medical check-ups. Isa sa
## advocacy ng Makati Life ang Preventive Care- and I’m glad that I get to be informed about this
## and have access to their quality service anytime. New facility, respectful employees and doctors,
## everything is top-notch.”

#### John Bryant Elamparo

### [Capsule Manufacturing][144]

Products may be designed in several capsule formats including colored, veggie and imprinted.

The smooth coating helps make softgels easy-to-swallow. Softgels also have a long product shelf
life.

### [Tablet Manufacturing][146]

Cost effective, good shelf life and ideal for certain types of formulas where dissolution timing is
critical.

### [Powder Manufacturing][147]

Practical for formulas measured in grams and offers flexible dosing options for protein or creatine
products.

### [Gummy Manufacturing][148]

Favored by children and adults, gummy vitamins deliver nutrients in a great tasting and fun chewable
candy format.

### [Flavor Systems][149]

Our flavor experts will invent a unique and delicious tasting product that consumers will prefer.

Manufacture a bodybuilding supplement like protein, creatine, pre-workout, fatburners, multivitamins
& more.

### [Sports Nutrition][151]

Customize a sports supplement for athletes seeking to enhance their physical and mental performance.

### [Protein Manufacturing][152]

Formulate your own protein supplement made from whey isolate or concentrate, casein, or plant-based
protein.

### [Pet Vitamins][153]

We formulate and manufacture chews, granulations, liquids, capsules and tablets for dogs and cats.

### [Vitamin Manufacturing][154]

Manufacture a pure vitamin / mineral formula, custom multivitamin or multivitamin pack.

### [Probiotics][155]

Work with our company to manufacture a probiotic product with maximum CFUs and microflora
activation.

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

translational and clinical research][97].

## Who We Are

### MeriCal^{®} is your go-to innovation and execution partner

Unlike most health supplement manufacturing companies, we don’t wait for you to tell us what you
need. We proactively identify market challenges and opportunities.

 

 

Our Innovation and R&D teams engineer clinically-backed supplement formulations and solutions with
fact-based recommendations that can be turned into deployable production runs with dependable
delivery on-time, in-full.

## Stay in-the-know

Probiotics, VMS, and next-generation wellness formats are exciting, but the science behind them can
get complex quickly. That’s why we created the **MeriCal Innovation Brief**.

 

Each month, we break down what’s happening across probiotics, complex formulations, emerging health
categories, and supplement manufacturing in a way that’s practical, clear, and easy to follow.

 

From ingredient science and format innovation to market-ready product concepts and manufacturing
considerations, each issue is designed to help you stay closer to where the industry is heading.

# Welcome to Microbe Notes

[Microbe Notes Cover]

**Microbe Notes **is an educational platform covering study notes on microbiology, bacteriology,
virology, parasitology, mycology, immunology, molecular biology, biochemistry, computational
biology, laboratory, health, medical, and related branches of the life sciences. It was established
on 2018-07-20. It provides structured study notes and concept-focused explanations designed to
support undergraduate and graduate students, with particular usefulness for exam preparation in
A-level Biology, AP Biology, IB Biology, and university-level biology and microbiology programs
(BSc, MSc, MPhil, and PhD).

# Excellence in Pharmaceutical
# Ingredients and Formulations

High-quality pharmaceutical ingredients and innovative formulations, ensuring
compliance with global standards and supporting advancements in healthcare solutions.

[Learn More][64]

# Custom Ingredients for Food and Nutraceuticals

Quality Ingredients for Food and Nutraceuticals, focusing on health benefits, safety, and regulatory
compliance

[Learn More][65]

# Superior Dyes and Pigments Solutions

Vibrant, high-performance dyes and pigments tailored for diverse applications, including Textile,
Leather, Polymer, Paint, Ink, and Plastic industries

[Learn More][66]

# Cosmetic Ingredients for Advanced Formulations

Discover Molkem`s premium range of cosmetic ingredients, including actives, antioxidants,
emulsifiers, and UV filters

[Learn More][67]

# Specialty and Fine Chemicals

High performance portfolio of Specialty and Performance Chemicals comprises of a wide range of
products
like Intermediates, Catalysts, Chelating Agents, Precursors, Oxidizing Agents, and Polymers.

[Learn More][68]



Molkem specializes in delivering high-quality ingredients and formulations for the Pharmaceutical,
Food, Nutraceutical, and Cosmetic industries. Further, we proudly carry forward our legacy in
specialty chemicals, dyes, and pigments, meeting the diverse needs of industries including Textile,
Leather, Polymer, Paint, Ink, and Plastics. Our continued commitment to these sectors ensures
consistent quality and innovation for our valued partners

With headquarters in India, Molkem has established a significant global presence, operating three
distribution centers located in India, Dubai, and Brazil. This network is further enhanced by our
subsidiaries in Brazil, Vietnam, and Dubai, as well as sales offices in Argentina and Colombia. Our
state-of-the-art R&D and analytical development center - Molkem Labs in Ahmedabad, India, is
set offers R&D, Tech Transfer and CDMO services for oral solids, parentrals, and novel drug delivery
systems.

[Learn More][69]

FAQ

## Common Questions

[All FAQ ][34]
What is OEM in cosmetics?

OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) means you supply the formula and the Korean manufacturer
produces it under your brand name. You own the formula IP and retain full exclusivity — no other
brand can use the same formula. It's the right model when product differentiation is the priority.

What is ODM — and how is it different from OEM?

With ODM (Original Design Manufacturer), the manufacturer's R&D team develops the formula to your
brief. You specify the product type, actives, and target market — they develop it, you approve and
brand it. ODM is faster and lower-cost to start than OEM, and is the most common path for brands
entering Korean manufacturing.

What is the difference between private label and white label?

White label is a fully standardized existing product — you apply your label as-is, no changes.
Private label allows minor customization: fragrance selection, color adjustments, or packaging
changes, on an existing base formula. Both are faster and lower-MOQ than custom ODM formulation.

What is the minimum order quantity for Korean OEM?

MOQs depend on the manufacturer tier and product type. Private label cosmetics: 1,000–2,000 units.
Custom ODM cosmetics: 1,000–5,000 units. Supplements (drink ampoules, capsules): 3,000–10,000 units.
Tier 1 industrial-scale Korean manufacturers typically require 5,000–10,000+ units. Most emerging
brands start with mid-size Korean manufacturers at 1,000–3,000 unit MOQs.

How long does it take to launch a product from a Korean manufacturer?

Private label (existing formula): 6–10 weeks from order confirmation. Custom ODM (new formula
development): 16–24 weeks, including formulation, stability testing, packaging, and production. Plan
for the longer estimate — the most common delays are sampling revision rounds and packaging
decisions.

Why do global brands choose Korean manufacturers?

Korea ranks #3 globally in cosmetics exports and sets the global benchmark for skincare formulation
quality and regulatory compliance. Korean manufacturers are MFDS-registered, ISO 22716 certified,
and export to the US, EU, UK, and Asia. The same factories producing leading K-beauty brands are
accessible to international brands at 1,000+ unit MOQs.

FAQ

## Common Questions

[All FAQ ][34]
What is OEM in cosmetics?

OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) means you supply the formula and the Korean manufacturer
produces it under your brand name. You own the formula IP and retain full exclusivity — no other
brand can use the same formula. It's the right model when product differentiation is the priority.

What is ODM — and how is it different from OEM?

With ODM (Original Design Manufacturer), the manufacturer's R&D team develops the formula to your
brief. You specify the product type, actives, and target market — they develop it, you approve and
brand it. ODM is faster and lower-cost to start than OEM, and is the most common path for brands
entering Korean manufacturing.

What is the difference between private label and white label?

White label is a fully standardized existing product — you apply your label as-is, no changes.
Private label allows minor customization: fragrance selection, color adjustments, or packaging
changes, on an existing base formula. Both are faster and lower-MOQ than custom ODM formulation.

What is the minimum order quantity for Korean OEM?

MOQs depend on the manufacturer tier and product type. Private label cosmetics: 1,000–2,000 units.
Custom ODM cosmetics: 1,000–5,000 units. Supplements (drink ampoules, capsules): 3,000–10,000 units.
Tier 1 industrial-scale Korean manufacturers typically require 5,000–10,000+ units. Most emerging
brands start with mid-size Korean manufacturers at 1,000–3,000 unit MOQs.

How long does it take to launch a product from a Korean manufacturer?

Private label (existing formula): 6–10 weeks from order confirmation. Custom ODM (new formula
development): 16–24 weeks, including formulation, stability testing, packaging, and production. Plan
for the longer estimate — the most common delays are sampling revision rounds and packaging
decisions.

Why do global brands choose Korean manufacturers?

Korea ranks #3 globally in cosmetics exports and sets the global benchmark for skincare formulation
quality and regulatory compliance. Korean manufacturers are MFDS-registered, ISO 22716 certified,
and export to the US, EU, UK, and Asia. The same factories producing leading K-beauty brands are
accessible to international brands at 1,000+ unit MOQs.

# **How Does Prime Biome Work?**

Prime Biome works by cultivating a thriving, well-balanced gut ecosystem. The gastrointestinal tract
houses a vast network of beneficial microbes that are crucial for breaking down food, absorbing
vital nutrients, supporting immune function, and influencing dermatological health. When this
internal ecosystem is in harmony, the body functions more efficiently, optimizing daily nutrient
uptake and reinforcing overall vitality.

⭐ **Rebalancing the Gut Ecosystem
**The supplement's core mechanism combines live, beneficial probiotics with targeted botanical
extracts to cultivate an optimal digestive environment. These friendly bacteria help replenish the
gut's defenses, which are often depleted by everyday stressors such as poor nutrition, chronic
tension, aging, and certain medications. Restoring these microbial populations helps alleviate
common digestive issues, encourages regular bowel habits, and enhances the body's ability to extract
energy from meals.

⭐ **Leveraging the Gut-Skin Connection **
Beyond basic digestion, Prime Biome incorporates plant-based antioxidants that defend cells against
environmental free radicals and oxidative damage. This internal defense directly impacts external
appearance via the gut-skin pathway. A balanced microbiome naturally assists the body's inflammatory
responses, which manifest externally as calmer, healthier, and more resilient skin.

⭐ **Maximizing Energy and Vitality **
An optimized digestive tract also plays a hidden role in combating daily fatigue. Because a healthy
gut processes food and absorbs vitamins more effectively, the body gains a reliable, clean source of
fuel for day-to-day activities.

To achieve the best outcomes, Prime Biome should be taken consistently alongside a wellness-focused
lifestyle that prioritizes balanced nutrition, routine exercise, proper hydration, and restful
sleep. While personal experiences will naturally differ, daily use provides the foundation for
better digestive comfort, vibrant skin, and enhanced physical well-being.

Quality System
Punature's Quality Management Philosophy
[Quality and Food Safety Management Platform]
Quality and Food Safety Management Platform

Punature strictly follows the ISO9001, ISO 22000, Kosher and Halal food quality certification
requirements, and strictly controls every link of the production process from raw material
procurement to finished products. The entire supply chain is under the control of the comprehensive
quality and food safety management system, forming a closed loop to strictly control product
quality.

Learn More
[Standards and Regulations Platform]
Standards and Regulations Platform

In order to meet the needs of the global market, Punature continues to expand its product access in
various countries and has obtained certification as halal, kosher, vegan, non-GMO among others for
our products. The quality and safety of Punature products has been recognized in China and abroad.
Punature guarantees the quality compliance of its products and has been sold to Southeast Asia,
Russia, Eastern and Western Europe, North and South America, and many other countries and regions,
and has been recognized by more than 140 countries and regions around the world.

Learn More
[Testing Platform]
Testing Platform

With advanced detecting instruments and experienced specialists, all our products are tested
carefully and thoroughly, which ensuring all the parameters meet the quality standards.

Learn More
Testimonials

Discover why global brands trust Punature! Our clients across 50+ countries consistently praise our
premium ingredients, reliable quality, and exceptional service. Read their success stories and
experience the difference yourself!

## Pay It Forward with Probiotics to Heal the
## Planet + You

Our beautiful friendship with the helpful microbes we call probiotics goes back all the way to the
beginning of humanity. We evolved to live together with these microbes. As we ate, we fed them and
helped them grow. In return, they broke down nutrients from our food, helped manage our immune
systems and kept out intruders, and so much more. It was their job to keep us in balance. As we
learned more and built more medical knowledge, we built more and better tools to help keep us
healthy as well.

[Learn more about how we’re reducing petrochemical(aka synthetic chemical) use with our probiotics
][13]

## Stronger Through Our Communities of Life

We are not separate from nature—we are nature. Our bodies are vibrant ecosystems, teeming with
microbial life that connects us to the world around us. When that balance is disrupted, our
health—and the planet’s—suffers.

Diverse, thriving ecosystems are the foundation of resilience, whether in a forest, a farm, or your
gut. Every choice you make—composting, reducing chemicals, nurturing soil—supports life, inside and
out.

Our probiotics are part of that daily commitment to live in harmony with nature. Because when we
care for the life within and around us, we all grow stronger.

## Better Living Through Natural Biochemistry

We believe that the more we treat biology like isolated chemistry, the further we get away from
healing. We research, patent, and manufacture products using a bioactive community of live
probiotics + fermented postbiotics to restore health to life on Earth.

**Traditionally Fermented, Scientifically Designed with Nature, Backed by Science**

As pioneers in microbiome science, we’ve been studying and manufacturing our probiotics for 22+
years. And unlike other probiotic companies, we’re not purchasing and repackaging isolated, frozen
and dried probiotic strains—that are designed knowing many won’t survive digestion to make it your
gut.

We combine traditional fermentation methods, precision-tuned by science, to design probiotic
products that are as close to nature as possible, most bioavailable, and carefully controlled for
real health results—whether we’re talking about soil health, plant health, animal health, or human
health.

**Our Bioactive Community **

We grow our microbes together. When we bottle them, they’re alive and active. Instead of competing
with each other, they form a strong, supportive ecosystem where they rely on each other for
survival.

This makes them an ultra-effective team that works together to survive harsh environments, actually
get to where you need it to go, and stay alive so it can work.

**Postbiotics for More Health Benefits **

As the 11 probiotic strains in SCD Essential Probiotics grow together, some of them grow first and
make postbiotics first. Other probiotics in the ecosystem eat those postbiotics. They become a
symbiotic community: a beautiful example of depending on each other to thrive together.

These postbiotics are key to our probiotics’ high survivability and stability. These postbiotics are
also highly beneficial to your health: they include bioactives that include antioxidants, organic
acids, short-chain fatty acids, and bioavailable forms of nutrients.

Most other probiotics are isolated from the postbiotics they make, then bottled. Even most
postbiotic supplements use isolated postbiotics that are then packaged together with other lab-grown
ingredients at bottling.

In every SCD Probiotics bottle, you’re getting a living ecosystem of both probiotics and
postbiotics, that are readily available to start influencing health.

It’s nature + science at its finest.

gut.

products that are as close to nature as possible, most bioavailable, and carefully controlled for
real health results—whether we’re talking about soil health, plant health, animal health, or human
health.

We grow our microbes together. When we bottle them, they’re alive and active. Instead of competing
with each other, they form a strong, supportive ecosystem where they rely on each other for
survival.

This makes them an ultra-effective team that works together to survive harsh environments, actually
get to where you need it to go, and stay alive so it can work.

As the 11 probiotic strains in SCD Essential Probiotics grow together, some of them grow first and
make postbiotics first. Other probiotics in the ecosystem eat those postbiotics. They become a
symbiotic community: a beautiful example of depending on each other to thrive together.

also highly beneficial to your health: they include bioactives that include antioxidants, organic
acids, short-chain fatty acids, and bioavailable forms of nutrients.

postbiotic supplements use isolated postbiotics that are then packaged together with other lab-grown
ingredients at bottling.

In every SCD Probiotics bottle, you’re getting a living ecosystem of both probiotics and
postbiotics, that are readily available to start influencing health.

It’s nature + science at its finest.

our lives to thrive, but they’re on the decline in our environment and our own bodies. And other
probiotics aren’t delivered alive and active, so they’re not as effective. So we use science to
refine and concentrate our probiotics, while empowering them to do what they do best. Which is eat,
grow, create, and help us thrive.

life, farm, or business, and easier to lead a healthier, more connected, and more sustainable life
on Earth.

dietary needs, with zero animal testing.

not purchasing and repackaging isolated, frozen, and inactive probiotics and nutrients.

postbiotics.

97% of our products are fermented, manufactured, packaged, and quality tested here in our partially
solar-powered US facilities.

Each of the strains in our patented probiotic communities are rigorously, scientifically-selected,
metagenomically studied, and stress-tested as multi-strain teams.

probiotics’ high quality and viability as live, active probiotics from our bottling line to their
destination. Plus, it makes them super easy to use, store, ship, and travel with.

Microbes link us together and empower health planet-wide. Our breakthrough, patented probiotic
technology is more than simply non-toxic: it’s restoring healtheverywhere it goes.

## through community.

prioritizing our connections with people across the world and with nature. In rebuilding our health

levels, we use 22+ years of microbiome research and scientific precision to design health-building
products that work incredibly well by mirroring nature as closely as possible.

Look under the microscope at iVS-1
The world’s most researched strain of *B. adolescentis* should be included in today’s biotic-based
supplements as a foundational strain supporting gastrointestinal health, wellbeing and longevity.
Introducing iVS-1^{®}
*B. adolescentis*
Most species of *Bifidobacterium* decline as we get older. However, research has shown that
*B. adolescentis*, in particular, remains abundant in healthy children and adults throughout life,
and is considered vital to a balanced gut microbiota, potentially possessing anti-aging properties.
Despite the significant presence of *B. adolescentis* in the human microbiome throughout life, most
of today’s dietary supplements are missing this key microbe for lifelong health.

The IVS Platform Emerges
Researchers working at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln (UNL) develop a next-generation screening
system, The IVS Platform™, to study the growth and behavior of probiotics within the human gut

supplements as a foundational strain supporting gastrointestinal health, wellbeing and longevity.
Introducing iVS-1^{®}
*B. adolescentis*
Most species of *Bifidobacterium* decline as we get older. However, research has shown that
*B. adolescentis*, in particular, remains abundant in healthy children and adults throughout life,
and is considered vital to a balanced gut microbiota, potentially possessing anti-aging properties.
Despite the significant presence of *B. adolescentis* in the human microbiome throughout life, most
of today’s dietary supplements are missing this key microbe for lifelong health.

University of Nebraska

The University of Nebraska-Lincoln is marking more than 100 years of research into probiotics and
the discovery of beneficial microbes. One significant achievement was the development of
*Lactobacillus acidophilus* DDS^{®}-1, which continues to be one of the most popular probiotic
strains in the world. By 2018, when the **Nebraska Food for Health Center** was established, over
**50 faculty, staff, and students** were **actively researching gut health**. That same year, a new
5,000 square-foot facility was built, including a gut biology lab, a clinical research center, an
analytical lab, and other specialized research spaces.

DDS^{®}-1 is a registered trademark of Novonesis A/S.
Synbiotic Health

Synbiotic Health was founded in 2018 by four leading microbiome researchers from the **University of
Nebraska-Lincoln: Dr. Bob Hutkins, Dr. Andy Benson, Dr. Jens Walter, and Dr. Tom Burkey**, who
together have over 100 years of experience in the field. Tim Brummels joined the company as CEO in
2019. Their signature probiotic strain, **iVS-1^{®}**, was discovered in the university’s research
labs and is exclusively licensed to Synbiotic Health. The company’s mission is to develop vital
probiotic microbes aimed at improving quality of life, supporting healthy aging, and enhancing
overall human health

Strain Collection

Synbiotic Health, in close coordination with the University of Nebraska-Lincoln, has amassed a large
collection of human-origin strains, as well a unique portfolio of canine-derived strains.

**Human strains**
**850** isolates identified by sequencing
**> 400** *Lactobacillus* and *Bifidobacterium* strains
**30** genome sequenced and characterized strains
**20** strains with pre-clinical properties
**9** strains in pre-production & sc

University of Nebraska

The University of Nebraska-Lincoln is marking more than 100 years of research into probiotics and
the discovery of beneficial microbes. One significant achievement was the development of
*Lactobacillus acidophilus* DDS^{®}-1, which continues to be one of the most popular probiotic
strains in the world. By 2018, when the **Nebraska Food for Health Center** was established, over
**50 faculty, staff, and students** were **actively researching gut health**. That same year, a new
5,000 square-foot facility was built, including a gut biology lab, a clinical research center, an
analytical lab, and other specialized research spaces.

DDS^{®}-1 is a registered trademark of Novonesis A/S.
Synbiotic Health

Synbiotic Health was founded in 2018 by four leading microbiome researchers from the **University of
Nebraska-Lincoln: Dr. Bob Hutkins, Dr. Andy Benson, Dr. Jens Walter, and Dr. Tom Burkey**, who
together have over 100 years of experience in the field. Tim Brummels joined the company as CEO in
2019. Their signature probiotic strain, **iVS-1^{®}**, was discovered in the university’s research
labs and is exclusively licensed to Synbiotic Health. The company’s mission is to develop vital
probiotic microbes aimed at improving quality of life, supporting healthy aging, and enhancing
overall human health

## Where Patients are Partners

The Medical City, one of the premier hospitals in the Philippines, has defined for itself the value
proposition: "Where Patients are Partners." This phrase finds its fullest meaning when the patient
is viewed not as a problem to be solved or a charge to be cared for, but as a partner in his own
health.

[stethoscope icon]

With JCI's Gold Seal of Approval you are guaranteed a world-class healthcare experience at The
Medical City

## Why Choose The Medical City?

The Medical City is not like any other health center in the Philippines. Our world-class hospital
and medical center are the staging areas for the delivery of cutting-edge health care services, with
centers of excellence in wellness and aesthetics, cardiovascular, cancer and regenerative medicine.
